name: list_coins
description: All ~25k tracked coins — id, name, symbol, rank, is_active.

name: get_coin
description: Full coin profile — description, team, links, tags.

name: tickers_latest
description: Latest price + market cap + volume. Without coin_id returns all tickers; with coin_id returns one.

name: historical_ohlc
description: Daily OHLC + volume + market cap for a coin. Defaults to the last 30 days when no date range is supplied. Free tier: up to 1 year back.

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD or unix timestamp. Optional — defaults to 30 days ago.

end.description: YYYY-MM-DD or unix timestamp (optional, defaults to now).

name: global_market
description: Total market cap, 24h volume, BTC dominance, active currencies.

name: search
description: Fuzzy search Coinpaprika across coins, exchanges, ICOs, people, and tags by free-text query; returns up to 250 results with id, name, symbol, and rank.
